_notes: This ledger is the Task ledger and the only shared ledger — it holds the Task list, status and dependencies. Only the orchestrator (Z) writes it. A and B only read it.
One Task = one run of the pipeline. Each Task has one room log/T{N}_<job>/, and the <job> in the room name is kept the same as 'name' in tasks.
Even when several work at the same time — even when several Tasks run in parallel — only Z writes to this file. That is why there are no conflicts.
Each assignee's summary is not in this file but is split into per-assignee files inside its own Task room: log/T{N}_<job>/build-summary/A<N>_*.md · log/T{N}_<job>/verification-summary/B<N>_*.md
This file records only 'what is where'. The content itself is in each deliverable file.
The value plugin:zab of _meta.pipeline_repo is a marker that the role documents and definitions are inside the zab plugin. The absolute path is given by the commands and the session banner.

<T1 | T2 | …>.name: <job — the same as the <job> in the room name T{N}_<job>>
depends_on: <ID of a Task that must finish first — empty array if none>
<T1 | T2 | …>.current_step: <step identifier — append R{M} for rework. e.g. step 3 R2>

agents.scope: <one line on the share this assignee took>

checkpoints.step: <identifier of the step that carries a ★>
reviewed: <path of a file the person opened>

verdict.result: <the one line the synthesizing verifier gave, verbatim>

history.task: <T{N} — which Task this belongs to. Empty for project work outside a Task>
